scope: Static independent review of the first consumer implementation and its model-free controls; no native execution

findings.problem: The driver records but does not require each successful child's before/after source hashes to equal the driver's initial hashes. It also does not bind child role, schema, mode, index, protocol and archive identity to the launched command. Mixed-source child evidence could therefore reach aggregation.
findings.required_change: Validate successful child identity and both source maps against the launch contract before aggregation. Preserve the original child report and reported outcome when parent admission fails. Add model-free controls for mismatched source and identity.

findings.problem: The summary labels eight panel cases as unique operational input types, although the separate cycle text is a ninth distinct text.
findings.required_change: Distinguish eight panel case types from nine distinct text inputs including the cycle text. Retain the correct counts of 24 panel executions, 78 cycle/warmup executions, and 102 context/document pairs.

model_free_controls.independent_rerun_blocker: Filesystem was full; bwrap failed before the requested command began with No space left on device.

completion_condition: Review the corrected source, pass its new model-free controls, save and verify the exact source remotely, then execute the unchanged operational protocol and retain its first result.
